text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ugh… It hurts. My head is pounding.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Why was the teacher so angry? Even Mom and Dad wouldn't be this mad…
choice_data_list: Why did you get in trouble?
Why did you get in trouble?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I wanted to see Prez, so I opened the door of the student council office…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But the teacher was all "Teio! What do you think you're doing, entering the student council office willy-nilly?!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Ouuuch! Just remembering it makes me wince all over again…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Teio's splitting headache continues to bother her for the rest of the day…
